recipe.visualDefinition: A portrait of a female artist reclining on a textured neutral sofa, featuring high-contrast lighting, warm sepia-toned highlights, and a mix of bold, slanted industrial typography and casual handwriting.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered but leaning diagonally to create dynamic movement.
Text blocks anchored in opposite corners (top-left and bottom-right) for balance.
Warm, golden-hour lighting contrasting with dark, saturated clothing tones.
Rough textures in the sofa and clothing juxtaposed with smooth skin tones.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a woman reclining diagonally across the frame, occupying approximately 60% of the visual space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bold top-left typography act as primary anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left text, follow the subject's diagonal body line down to the bottom-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The textured sofa provides a consistent, non-distracting negative space around the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and tan (background and skin highlights).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (clothing and hair).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow and metallic bronze (text borders and belt details).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark clothing and light background; moderate saturation focused on warm tones.

letterConstructionRules: Display text must be heavily italicized (oblique).
Display text features a thick black stroke and a gold/tan outer glow or drop shadow.
Secondary text must appear as loose, marker-style handwriting.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the display title are tightly tracked to the point of near-overlap.

composition.relationshipToImage: layered on top with drop shadow

graphicDevices: Rectangular text backing boxes with slight transparency
Heavy drop shadows to separate text from busy textures

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and industrial feel of the primary text.
Captures the casual, handwritten secondary text style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a woman with long dark hair reclining on a 1970s-style tan textured sofa. She is wearing a black pinstripe tank top and a wide studded belt. Lighting should be warm and directional, creating soft shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the primary title in a heavy, slanted sans-serif font in the top-left corner with a gold outline. Apply the secondary title in a black marker-style script in the bottom-right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette predominantly warm?
Does the text have sufficient contrast against the background?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the warm color grade
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Any specific brand logos on clothing
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast lighting on the subject's face.
Ensure the text doesn't obscure the subject's eyes.
Verify the 'marker' texture on the secondary font.
Confirm the background texture is visible and detailed.
recipe.reuseFormula: Reclining diagonal subject + Warm sepia lighting + Heavy oblique sans-serif (top-left) + Marker script (bottom-right) = Country Rock Aesthetic.
